messages:
alejandra: opened a PR to tighten SOC2 audit-log guidance: clarified retention TTL vs exports, added Python + Java SDK snippets, a small migration mapping, and fixed a broken CLI anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/600
tom: quick pass 1 looks good. please be explicit that exports are snapshots and do NOT extend or modify tenant TTLs. also call out roles that can request exports or change retention (Org Admin, Compliance). auditors want 'indefinite' instead of 'permanent'.
alejandra: updated wording: 'Exports are immutable snapshots taken at request time and do not modify the configured retention TTL. Only Organization Admins and users assigned the Compliance role may request exports, place or release legal holds, or change retention settings.' switched to 'indefinite' where needed.
irene: adding Python + Java SDK examples. also included a tiny migration mapping note: old_event.user_email -> actor.email; old_event.ts -> timestamp. will add a curl example for migrating old event IDs.
alejandra: inserted snippets and a redaction failure example (customers asked about failure modes). example error: {"error":"redaction_not_allowed","message":"tenant redaction policy prevents removal of PII"} (HTTP 409).
legal-ops: wording looks fine. please add link to internal retention policy for auditors: https://internal/legal/retention-policy and a one-line legal-hold workflow. confirm RBAC note covers audit requirements.
alejandra: added internal link and one-line workflow: 'Legal places or releases holds via the compliance portal; holds suspend scheduled deletions and all hold actions are recorded in the audit trail.' also fixed the CLI anchor from /docs/cli#audit to /docs/cli#audit-export.
docs-ci: PR 600 updated, lint and link-check passed, staging build green.
alejandra: planning to merge tomorrow AM if no objections. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
